newsitem.title: UK: Burnfield to buy LDS, makes cash call. [CORRECTED 18:43 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Burnfield to buy LDS, makes cash call. [CORRECTED 18:43 GMT]

text.p: Burnfield Plc said on Friday it has agreed to buy Ling Dynamic Systems Ltd (LDS) for 24 million stg and will finance the acquisition through a rights issue which will raise around 20.3 million stg.

Burnfield is involved in manfacturing sophisticated test and measurement instruments (corrects from "involved in design, manufacture, sale and installation of electric surface heating for industry, pressure gauges and quality control equipment").
The company said the acquisition will be satisfied with a cash payment of 24.0 million stg with the balance 3.5 million being paid by the allotment of ordinary shares.
The rights issue will consist of seven new shares for every 10 existing Burnfield shares, at a price of 90p per share.

Burnfield also forecast a final dividend payment of 2.2p per share making a total of 3.5p for the year. It said it expects operating profit for the year ending December 31, will be not less than 3.5 million stg.

LDS, which designs and manufactures vibration testing equipment used by the aerospace, electronics and automotive industries, made pretax profits of 2.31 million stg in the year to July 31. It had net assets of 6.96 million by that date.
